articles.headline: Samsung profit surges on AI chip boom
articles.summary: Samsung’s Q3 profit reportedly jumped nearly ninefold as the AI chip cycle boosted earnings, with memory workers expected to receive large performance bonuses. The result signals strong demand in AI-related chips and memory, which affects supplier pricing, investment plans, and competitive strategy across the tech supply chain.

articles.headline: AI tools identified in cyberattacks on South Korean banks
articles.summary: Nikkei reported that AI tools were identified as part of attacks on South Korean banks, though the links between incidents remain under investigation. The business impact is clear: financial institutions and other firms should treat AI-assisted attacks as a real operational and compliance risk, especially for identity, fraud, and incident-response controls.

articles.headline: Navitas closes Claros acquisition to target AI data-center power bottlenecks
articles.summary: Navitas said the Claros acquisition expands its AI infrastructure power-delivery portfolio from the grid to the xPU, aimed at easing efficiency and power-density constraints in AI data centers. That matters for businesses because power delivery is becoming a hard limit on AI capacity, which can affect data-center buildouts, supplier demand, and the pace of AI deployment.
